body.title: The migration runner and the first-boot write run as child transactions
body.summary: src/db/graph/migrations.ts:442-448 runs each step and its version write in `store.root.childTransaction(async () => { ... })` (steps may stay async: they run inside the store's open before any caller can reach the store) and the comment at :444-446 says what holds; the first-boot write at src/db/graph/store.ts:607-610 uses `root.childTransaction`. src/db/graph/__tests__/migrations.test.ts gains row assertions: a step that writes rows and throws leaves neither its rows nor its version write, earlier steps stay committed.
acceptanceChecks: A throwing migration step leaves neither its rows nor its version write; earlier steps stay committed
A fresh store still boots at the current version with the shared-modules rows
